subject: Invoice discrepancy — AWS Marketplace metering & fulfillment (Acme Analytics)
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme.ai>
To: irene.choi@redwood.com
Cc: AWS Marketplace Support <aws-marketplace-support@amazon.com>, Ben Foster <ben.foster@procurepay.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Discrepancy on Marketplace invoice (Nov usage)

Hi Irene,

We noticed a material discrepancy between the usage numbers reported on the AWS Marketplace invoice we received and the usage CSV your fulfillment webhooks produced for our product (product-code: prod-ACME-001). The invoice is about $12,400 higher than expected for the month of Oct/Nov. I've attached the invoice PDF and the usage export we pulled from our side (usage_export_20271110.csv) — column headers included. Can you confirm whether Redwood submitted the same marketplace metering events to AWS that we see locally?

Quick context: we bill our customers on our side based on Redwoods' metering events; if Redwood submitted duplicate events (or if the entitlement mapping points to the wrong subscription), that would explain the overcharge. This is blocking our finance team from closing month-end.

Requested next steps:
- Can Redwood provide the fulfillment event log or marketplace invoice ID you used to reconcile?
- If this is a submission error, we need a provisional credit while we investigate.

Thanks — can we get a quick triage here today?

Samantha Lee
Head of Revenue Operations
Acme Analytics
attachments: acme_invoice_nov2027.pdf, usage_export_20271110.csv

From: irene.choi@redwood.com <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme.ai>
Cc: marcus.lin@redwood.com, aditya.rao@redwood.com, monica.patel@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2027 10:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Discrepancy on Marketplace invoice (Nov usage)

Thanks Samantha — appreciate the clear summary and the attachments. I've looped in Marcus (sales ops) and Aditya (billing) to help with the reconciliation; Monica from the integrations team can pull the raw fulfillment events if needed.

Immediate plan:
1) Aditya / Billing will pull the fulfillment event logs we sent to AWS for your product-code and the marketplace invoice IDs.
2) Marcus will create a short MAP (mutual action plan) so we have agreed owners and timelines.
3) If the numbers indicate an over-reporting on our side, we'll issue a provisional credit to Acme while we complete the root-cause and remediation.

Can you confirm the AWS marketplace "SellerId" and the contract SKU you expect us to be using? Also please confirm the Acme PO number so Marcus can include it in the MAP.

I'll follow up with a consolidated thread update within 24 business hours.

— Irene
Irene Choi
Senior Account Manager, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0198

From: marcus.lin@redwood.com <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme.ai>, irene.choi@redwood.com
Cc: aditya.rao@redwood.com, monica.patel@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2027 08:30:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Discrepancy on Marketplace invoice (Nov usage) — proposed MAP

Hi Samantha — thanks for flagging this. I'm proposing a 5-point MAP to keep the timeline tight:

1) Today (Nov 11): Redwood to provide the marketplace fulfillment event export and the AWS invoice IDs we used for Oct/Nov (Owner: Aditya).
2) Nov 12: Acme to reconcile the export against your internal usage CSV and flag specific event IDs or subscriptions that look duplicated (Owner: Samantha).
3) Nov 13: Joint sync (30 mins) to confirm mismatch scope and provisional credit amount + timing (Owners: Irene + Samantha).
4) Nov 14–15: Redwood engineering to patch any inference in our metering pipeline if root cause found (Owner: Monica).
5) Nov 15: Final reconciliation and formal credit/adjustment or confirmation of no action required (Owners: Finance teams).

I've created a HubSpot note and linked it here: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/89012345 — please use that record for all artifacts so Finance can trace the credit.

Also, Samantha — you mentioned PO number in your reply. If you can share that, I'll add it to the MAP and loop in legal if a contract amendment is needed.

Marcus Lin
Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference

From: aditya.rao@redwood.com <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: irene.choi@redwood.com, marcus.lin@redwood.com
Cc: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme.ai>, monica.patel@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 11 Nov 2027 11:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Discrepancy on Marketplace invoice (Nov usage) — fulfillment logs attached

Samantha / team — attaching the fulfillment event export we pushed to AWS for prod-ACME-001 (redwood_fulfillment_event_log_20271111.json) and the list of marketplace invoice IDs we reconciled against.

Notes from my initial pass:
- We see ~2,100 metering events between 2027-10-25 and 2027-11-05 that match your usage CSV rows; however there are ~470 events with the same timestamp pattern that map to a different entitlement_id (ent-ACME-OLD) which appears to be a legacy mapping. Those would have been billed to a different subscription on AWS, which could create double-counting if Acme's internal mapping merged both entitlement IDs into a single billing bucket.
- Action items: we need Acme to confirm which entitlement_id is active for billing. If ent-ACME-OLD should be ignored, we can retroactively revoke those metering submissions and propose a credit.

Provisional credit recommendation: $12,000 pending final reconciliation (we can post a credit note on Nov 15 if Acme confirms the entitlement mapping).

Attachments: redwood_fulfillment_event_log_20271111.json; marketplace_invoice_ids_202711.csv

— Aditya Rao
Billing Ops Lead
Redwood Inference

From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme.ai>
To: irene.choi@redwood.com, marcus.lin@redwood.com, aditya.rao@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 15 Nov 2027 14:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Discrepancy on Marketplace invoice (Nov usage) — follow-up + meeting

Thanks everyone — this is helpful. Confirming: our active entitlement for billing is ent-ACME-CURRENT (not ent-ACME-OLD). I've attached an updated usage export that filters out the legacy entitlement rows (usage_export_20271115-cleaned.csv).

Irene / Marcus — we can do the 30-minute sync tomorrow at 10:00am PST to confirm scope and the provisional credit. Ben from ProcurePay (cc'd on the original) will join to confirm PO and invoice handling on our end.

Once we confirm it's the legacy entitlement rows causing the double-billing, we're fine with Redwood issuing the provisional credit you suggested. Please share the formal credit note and any DocuSign amendment if required.

Onward — Samantha
Head of Revenue Operations
Acme Analytics
attachments: usage_export_20271115-cleaned.csv
